title: 6.5 Simple Directions
unit_outcome: Ask where a familiar place is, understand simple directions, and use familiar transportation and schedule language.
goal: Understand and say five short route commands using a clear overhead path.
grammar_function: Short positive imperative chunks for navigation.
speaking_outcome: Say go straight, turn left, turn right, cross the street, and stop.

cards.pedagogy_note: New command; not a road sign reading task.
